reference_sql:
WITH end_2024 AS (
  -- one row per segment
  SELECT a.segment, SUM(e.mrr_delta_local * f.eur_per_unit) AS mrr
  FROM subscription_events e
  JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id
  JOIN fx_rates f ON f.currency = s.currency AND f.rate_date = DATE '2025-12-31'
  JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = e.account_id
  WHERE e.event_date <= DATE '2024-12-31'
  GROUP BY a.segment
), end_2025 AS (
  -- one row per segment
  SELECT a.segment, SUM(e.mrr_delta_local * f.eur_per_unit) AS mrr
  FROM subscription_events e
  JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id
  JOIN fx_rates f ON f.currency = s.currency AND f.rate_date = DATE '2025-12-31'
  JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = e.account_id
  WHERE e.event_date <= DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY a.segment
)
SELECT y.segment, ROUND(x.mrr, 2) AS mrr_2024, ROUND(y.mrr, 2) AS mrr_2025, ROUND(y.mrr - x.mrr, 2) AS change_mrr
FROM end_2025 y
JOIN end_2024 x ON x.segment = y.segment
alternatives:
SELECT a.segment,
  ROUND(SUM(e.mrr_delta_local * f.eur_per_unit) FILTER (WHERE e.event_date <= DATE '2024-12-31'), 2) AS mrr_2024,
  ROUND(SUM(e.mrr_delta_local * f.eur_per_unit), 2) AS mrr_2025,
  ROUND(SUM(e.mrr_delta_local * f.eur_per_unit) FILTER (WHERE e.event_date > DATE '2024-12-31'), 2) AS change_mrr
FROM subscription_events e
JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id
JOIN fx_rates f ON f.currency = s.currency AND f.rate_date = DATE '2025-12-31'
JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = e.account_id
WHERE e.event_date <= DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY a.segment

WITH acct AS (
  -- one row per account, in euros
  SELECT a.segment,
    SUM(e.mrr_delta_local * f.eur_per_unit) FILTER (WHERE e.event_date <= DATE '2024-12-31') AS mrr_2024,
    SUM(e.mrr_delta_local * f.eur_per_unit) FILTER (WHERE e.event_date <= DATE '2025-12-31') AS mrr_2025
  FROM subscription_events e
  JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id
  JOIN fx_rates f ON f.currency = s.currency AND f.rate_date = DATE '2025-12-31'
  JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = e.account_id
  GROUP BY e.account_id, a.segment
)
SELECT segment, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(mrr_2024, 0)), 2) AS mrr_2024, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(mrr_2025, 0)), 2) AS mrr_2025,
  ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(mrr_2025, 0)) - SUM(COALESCE(mrr_2024, 0)), 2) AS change_mrr
FROM acct
GROUP BY segment

solver.query:
WITH ev AS (SELECT e.account_id, a.segment, e.event_type, e.event_date, s.currency, e.mrr_delta_local AS d, e.mrr_delta_local * f.eur_per_unit AS eur
  FROM subscription_events e JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = e.account_id
  JOIN fx_rates f ON f.currency = s.currency AND f.rate_date = DATE '2025-12-31'), t AS (SELECT segment, SUM(eur) FILTER (WHERE event_date <= DATE '2024-12-31') AS a, SUM(eur) FILTER (WHERE event_date <= DATE '2025-12-31') AS b FROM ev GROUP BY segment)
SELECT segment, ROUND(a, 2) AS mrr_2024, ROUND(b, 2) AS mrr_2025, ROUND(b - a, 2) AS change_mrr FROM t
